name: Collegio alla Querce,  Auberge Collection
insider_take: A Renaissance palazzo reborn as Florence's most sophisticated sanctuary, where centuries-old oak trees whisper tales of Medici grandeur.
whats_special: This former 15th-century convent turned luxury retreat sits in the prestigious Oltrarno district, featuring original frescoes, vaulted ceilings, and gardens that once hosted noble families. The hotel's name "alla Querce" (of the oaks) references the majestic oak trees that have graced the property for over 400 years, creating a rare green oasis in the heart of Florence.
pro_tip: Book a garden-facing room during spring when the historic oak trees bloom – you'll wake up to a private Renaissance painting come to life, just steps from the Pitti Palace.
dont_miss: The hotel's secret rooftop terrace offers unobstructed views of Brunelleschi's iconic dome, while the restored chapel now serves as an intimate cocktail bar. Walk 3 minutes to reach the Oltrarno's legendary artisan workshops where masters still craft leather goods and jewelry using techniques unchanged since the Renaissance.
pros: Historic luxury property in prestigious Florence location
Sophisticated design blending heritage with modern amenities
Auberge Collection's renowned personalized service standards
Prime access to Florence's art, culture, and culinary scene
cons: Historic building may have space limitations
